definitions.name: Industry fixed effects
definitions.definition_verbatim: ρj and νi capture industry and firm fixed effects, respectively
definitions.definition_verbatim_correction_note: Paper Section 3.2 (sentence following Equation 1) reads verbatim: "ρj and νi capture industry and firm fixed effects, respectively." Footnote 5 reads verbatim: "The industry dummies are constructed based on the 49‐industry classification of Fama and French (1997)." The input concatenates these two distinct locations as if a single verbatim quote, and transliterates the Greek letters ρ and ν (with subscripts j, i) as "rho_j" and "nu_i" -- the underscore characters are not present in the paper.
definitions.source_location_verbatim: Section 3.2 Estimation technique, equation (1) description and footnote 5

definitions.name: State fixed effects
definitions.definition_verbatim: θs represents a set of state dummies that account for state-level unobservable factors that could be correlated with the data breach disclosure laws, and thus bias our estimates
definitions.definition_verbatim_correction_note: Paper Section 3.2 (sentence following Equation 1) reads verbatim: "θs represents a set of state dummies that account for state‐level unobservable factors that could be correlated with the data breach disclosure laws, and thus bias our estimates". The input transliterates the Greek letter θ (theta) with subscript s as "theta_s" -- the underscore character is not present in the paper.
